title: Antigravity discovery
description: Implement discover() for the Antigravity adapter per the research: enumerate conversation/session stores under the real data roots, tolerate missing roots, attribute stable session ids. Done when: discovery tests pass on synthetic fixtures and a missing root is reported, not fatal.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done. createAntigravityAdapter().discover() scans ~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations (root/home overrides; missing roots reported in skipCounter.missingRoots, never fatal). Nested sub-cascades are excluded up front by joining conversation_summaries.parent_conversation_id (stale summary rows for missing files ignored); sessionId = conversation uuid from filename; projectPath decoded from workspace_uris file:// URIs with an 'antigravity' fallback. Fixture DBs are generated at test time (tests/unit/sentiment/helpers/antigravity-fixture.ts) — binary SQLite fixtures are never committed, matching the cursor IDE fixture pattern. Live check: 79 desktop (55 nested skipped) + 37 CLI = 61 sessions discovered.
